note: This file is a pure configuration dictionary (MMClassification config) with no callable functions, classes, or APIs. It defines model settings for a VisionTransformer (large, patch_size=16) backbone with an ImageClassifier head. No CLI-invocable code is present.
review_model_config: review the VisionTransformer large p16 model configuration dictionary for image classification
summarize_model_config: summarize the vit-large-p16 model settings including backbone, head, and loss configuration
build_vit_large_classifier: build an ImageClassifier with a VisionTransformer large backbone using patch size 16 and 1000 classes
refactor_model_config: refactor the vit-large-p16 model config to change the number of classes or dropout rate
test_model_config: test the vit-large-p16 model configuration by instantiating the ImageClassifier with the defined backbone and head
